display.description: A bundle of just the app playback streams.
display.name: All Apps

display.description: A bundle of every source: hardware inputs and app playback streams.  Feed it through Filters to pick some of them.
display.name: All Inputs

display.description: A bundle of every destination (hardware outputs and app recording streams) to route audio into.
display.name: All Outputs

display.description: A filter that matches every stream an *application* created - by the app scope behind the stream's process, so the app you know ("vesktop", "discord") matches all of its subprocesses at once.
display.name: Application

display.description: An application's audio output (playback stream).
display.name: App Playback

display.description: A filter that matches the *subprocess* behind a stream - PipeWire's application.name, which for an app that delegates its audio is the subprocess (an Electron app reports "Chromium input").
display.name: Subprocess

display.description: An application's recording input.
display.name: App Mic

display.description: A space boolean input port (control signal from outside to inside).
display.name: Bool Space In

display.description: A space boolean output port (control signal from inside to outside).
display.name: Bool Space Out

display.description: Publishes a boolean control signal under a name.
display.name: Bool Warp In

display.description: Reads the boolean control signal published under a name.
display.name: Bool Warp Out

display.description: True only when every wired input is true.
display.name: AND

display.description: Inverts a boolean signal (NOT).
display.name: Invert

display.description: True when any wired input is true.
display.name: OR

display.description: Fans one boolean signal out to two destinations.
display.name: Bool Splitter

display.description: A manual On/Off control signal. Wire it into gates and switches to drive them.
display.name: On/Off

display.description: True when exactly one wired input is true (odd parity).
display.name: XOR

display.description: Collects several lines or bundles into one bundle; it grows another input each time you plug one in.
display.name: Merge Bundle

display.description: Delivers the audio wired into it to every destination in a sink bundle.
display.name: Bundle Output

display.description: Takes a bundle apart: one output line per member, so each stream can be routed or processed on its own.
display.name: Split Bundle

display.description: Converts a source bundle back into one ordinary audio stream (all its members).
display.name: Bundle -> Audio

display.description: A momentary button: press it to fire an impulse down its wire. It holds no state - the pulse is the whole signal.
display.name: Button

display.description: A camera feed: one selected video source (webcam, capture card, virtual camera, ...) carried on a camera wire.
display.name: Camera In

display.description: A range of a sound: sound in, sound out.  The node is a timeline of the file - waveform, a yellow selection you drag the sides of, and the selection's start/end times - and what it passes on is that part of the sound.
display.name: Clip

display.description: A filter that matches by a text match on the description.
display.name: Description

display.description: Audio sources selected by a text match on their description.
display.name: Description In

display.description: A destination selected by a text match on its description.
display.name: Description Out

display.description: A hardware capture device (microphone, interface input, ...).
display.name: Hardware Input

display.description: A hardware playback device (speakers, headphones, ...).
display.name: Hardware Output

display.description: Removes speaker echo from a microphone using a probe/reference feed (WebRTC acoustic echo cancellation).
display.name: Echo Cancel

setting_tooltips.aec_args: Extra options passed to the AEC library, e.g. 'analog_gain_control=0 digital_gain_control=1'.
setting_tooltips.library_name: The AEC implementation to load. 'aec/libspa-aec-webrtc' is the WebRTC echo canceller.
setting_tooltips.monitor_mode: Automatically use the default sink as the echo reference instead of the probe input.

display.description: Passes audio through while excluding sources that match a regular expression from the mix.
display.name: Exclude (Regex)

display.description: A filter that keeps only real apps and hardware, stripping Patch Space's own plumbing.
display.name: External Only

display.description: Narrows a bundle to the members the classifiers plugged into its filter input(s) match (AND).  Its Include/Exclude switch keeps everything except those members when set to Exclude.
display.name: Filter

display.description: Passes or blocks audio, driven by a boolean control signal (or its own on/off button when nothing is wired to ctrl).
display.name: Gate

display.description: Takes two inputs (On/Off) and routes the selected one to its output.
display.name: Inv. Switcher

display.description: Mic-only denoiser using the same engine as Echo Cancel, with the probe input hidden.
display.name: Light Noise Cancel

setting_tooltips.aec_args: Extra options passed to the AEC library; use these to bias it toward noise suppression.
setting_tooltips.monitor_mode: Automatically use the default sink as the reference instead of a probe feed.

display.description: A filter that matches by PipeWire media class.
display.name: Media Class

display.description: Audio sources selected by their PipeWire media class (hardware inputs, sink monitors, app playback).
display.name: Media Class In

display.description: Destinations selected by their PipeWire media class (hardware outputs, app recording streams).
display.name: Media Class Out

display.description: AI (RNNoise) denoiser for a microphone signal.
display.name: AI Noise Cancel

setting_tooltips.ladspa_label: Override the RNNoise plugin label. Blank = auto (uses the stereo variant).
setting_tooltips.ladspa_plugin: Override the librnnoise_ladspa.so path. Blank = find it automatically.
setting_tooltips.vad_threshold: How confident RNNoise must be that a frame is speech before passing it through. Higher = more aggressive.

display.description: Loudness normalization with a lookahead limiter, so quiet speech can be lifted without blasting when it resumes.
display.name: Normalize

setting_tooltips.boost_db: Input gain applied before the limiter.
setting_tooltips.ladspa_dir: Directory holding the swh LADSPA plugins. Blank = find them automatically.
setting_tooltips.leveling: Enable the sc4 leveling compressor ahead of the limiter.
setting_tooltips.threshold_db: Compressor threshold: below this the compressor does nothing.

display.description: A space input port: wire audio in from outside; inside the space it acts as a source.
display.name: Space In

display.description: A space output port: wire audio to it from inside the space; outside it acts as a source.
display.name: Space Out

display.description: A line to the built-in Patch Space speaker device.
display.name: Speaker Line

display.description: A line to the built-in Patch Space microphone device.
display.name: Mic Line

display.description: Records what is wired into it: an audio input, and a sound output pointing at the take.  Record starts a fresh take (overwriting the last), Stop finishes it, and the node shows the take's waveform and length.
display.name: Recorder

display.description: A filter that matches by regular expression on the node/app name.
display.name: Regex

display.description: Audio sources whose node name matches a regular expression (e.g. every app playback stream).
display.name: Regex In

display.description: A destination picked by matching a regular expression against node names.
display.name: Regex Out

display.description: Keeps the last few seconds of what is wired into it: an audio input, and a sound output pointing at the clip.  It records continuously, so the clip is already there when you want it - press Clip and the last N seconds become a file, a retrospective take you make *after* the thing you wanted happened.
display.name: Replay Buffer

display.description: Adds reverb; the inline slider sets the dry/wet mix.
display.name: Reverb

setting_tooltips.decay_time: How long the reverb tail lasts.
setting_tooltips.hf_damp: Frequency above which the tail is damped.
setting_tooltips.plugin_uri: Override the LV2 plugin URI. Blank = Calf Reverb.
setting_tooltips.predelay: Delay before the reverb starts, in milliseconds.
setting_tooltips.room_size: Apparent size of the simulated room.

display.description: A voice-activity gate that opens on speech and closes on silence.
display.name: Sensitivity

setting_tooltips.attack_ms: How quickly the gate opens when speech starts.
setting_tooltips.knee_db: Softness of the transition around the threshold.
setting_tooltips.lv2_uri: Override the LV2 gate plugin URI. Blank = Calf Gate.
setting_tooltips.range_db: Level the gate drops to when closed (-96 dB = silence).
setting_tooltips.ratio: How hard the gate attenuates below the threshold.
setting_tooltips.release_ms: How long before the gate closes after speech stops.
setting_tooltips.sensitivity: 0..1: how easily sound opens the gate (1 = most sensitive).

display.description: A sound: an audio file of known length, on its own port kind.  It makes no noise itself - a Sound Player fires it, a Clip node returns part of it - so it has no inputs, just a sound output.
display.name: Sound

display.description: Writes the sound wired into it to a file whenever an impulse arrives: a sound input, an impulse input, and no outputs at all.  It saves to its folder and name as Opus, so what it writes is small and plays anywhere - the sink for a sound, where the Sound Player is the source.
display.name: Sound Dump

display.description: Plays the sound wired into it whenever an impulse arrives: a sound input, an impulse input, an audio output.  The Stack switch picks whether a new impulse restarts it or stacks another take.
display.name: Sound Player

display.description: Passes audio straight through; useful as a named junction that several edges can share.
display.name: Splitter

display.description: Routes its input to the On or Off output, chosen by a boolean control signal.
display.name: Switcher

display.description: A filter that matches a stream's title - PipeWire's media.name, the label a mixer shows for a playing app ("YouTube", a track name).
display.name: Title

display.description: A virtual camera on a v4l2 device: republishes the camera feed wired into it on an output device (VirtualCamN), so other apps can pick it up as a camera.
display.name: V4L2 Virtual Cam

display.description: A virtual camera in the PipeWire system: republishes the camera feed wired into it as a video source other PipeWire-aware apps can pick as a camera.
display.name: Virtual Cam

display.description: A named virtual microphone other applications can record from.
display.name: Virtual Mic

display.description: A named virtual speaker other applications can play into.
display.name: Virtual Speaker

display.description: Adjusts the level of whatever passes through it.
display.name: Volume

display.description: Publishes whatever is plugged into it under a name, so a Warp Out elsewhere can pull it in.
display.name: Warp In

display.description: Pulls in everything published under a name (mixes multiple publishers).
display.name: Warp Out
